name: Mobile Checkout Gateway Bug
description: Release v2.4.0 deployed on 2026-09-15 introduced a bug in the mobile checkout payment gateway SDK, causing ~75% of checkout attempts on mobile sessions running v2.4.0 or later to fail with payment_gateway_timeout. Mobile users adopt the new app version gradually.
ground_truth_cause: Release v2.4.0 introduced an unhandled network timeout in the mobile checkout SDK. Mobile orders from app version >= v2.4.0 fail at 75% rate; users upgrade over ~2 days after 2026-09-15 10:00 UTC.

expected_observable_effects.orders: Sharp spike in status='failed' with failure_reason='payment_gateway_timeout' exclusively on mobile
expected_observable_effects.daily_product_metrics: Drop in completed_orders and gross_revenue after Sept 15; failed_orders surges
expected_observable_effects.user_feedback: Spike in negative feedback (rating 1-2) with category='billing'/'checkout' on mobile
expected_observable_effects.releases: Correlates directly with deployment of release_id 'rel_240' on 2026-09-15
